crossRefs.note: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword…
These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by Yahweh, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep…
His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great.…
“Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because Yahweh has blessed us so far?”
translations.bsb: Then the sons of Joseph said to Joshua, “Why have you given us only one portion as an inheritance? We have many people, because the LORD has blessed us abundantly.”
translations.kjv: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?
translations.asv: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one part for an inheritance, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as hitherto Jehovah hath blessed me?
